subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — NDA gating and audit-period confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@fintechco.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: 2028-09-19T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II access request (NDA required)

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — we’re finalizing our vendor security review for a potential integration and would like to request Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12-month period. Our security team also typically requests a short bridge letter if the report’s coverage ends more than 90 days prior to onboarding.

We’re unable to accept raw reports without an NDA in place; please send a countersigned NDA (we can sign first if that speeds things up). Also can you confirm the audit period covered in the report (start/end dates) and whether there will be any redactions?

If easier, loop in legal and security on your side and we’ll do the countersign via DocuSign. Our procurement contact copied (procurement@fintechco.com) will coordinate the PO if we move forward.

Thanks — a quick reply with next steps would be great.

— Elena
Elena Morris
Senior Information Security Manager
FintechCo

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request (NDA required)

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the clear ask. I’ve looped in Legal (Laura) and Security (Rishi) so we can get the NDA countersigned and confirm the audit window / redaction approach.

Quick answers up front:
- We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II once we have a countersigned NDA.
- We’ll provide a bridge letter if the audit period ends >90 days before onboarding (we draft a short statement referencing the covered period).

Action items:
1) I’m attaching our standard mutual NDA for your signature (stub attached — we can also send via DocuSign if you prefer).
2) Laura — can you review for countersign and confirm if DocuSign is OK?
3) Rishi — can you confirm the audit period in the 2027 Type II and whether any control descriptions need mandatory redaction (e.g., customer PII examples)?

Elena — once we have the countersigned NDA I’ll route the redacted report and bridge letter (target: within 2 business days of countersign). If procurement needs PO details, Monica is the internal contact.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_Standard_Mutual.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@fintechco.com>

Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: 2028-09-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request (NDA required)

Ben — thanks, DocuSign is fine. We’ll sign and return today. Two clarifying items from our security team:

1) Audit period: we need a firm start/end date (e.g., 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31) to validate control coverage. Please confirm exact dates in the report.
2) Redactions: our policy allows vendor redaction of internal IP and provider-specific network diagrams, but we need unredacted control descriptions for logical access, change management, and incident response.

Do you expect any additional gating beyond the NDA (e.g., supplemental questionnaires, SOC2 extracts)?

I will send countersigned NDA via DocuSign shortly — Samir in procurement will confirm PO process after we validate.

Thanks,
Elena

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@fintechco.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request (NDA required)

Elena — thanks for the note. We received your request and countersign via DocuSign came through a few minutes ago (DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/FintechCo/Envelope/ABC123). Attached is the countersigned NDA (PDF stub).

Regarding your two points:
- Audit period: The SOC 2 Type II report we will share covers the period 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31.
- Redactions: Redwood’s practice is to redact provider-internal architecture diagrams and any customer-identifying screenshots. Control narratives for logical access, change management, incident response, and monitoring are provided unredacted unless they contain customer-specific data. If you flag a specific excerpt for review, Rishi’s team will handle the redaction review.

We’ll also include a brief bridge letter referencing the above audit period and confirming no material control changes since the report date. Expect the redacted report + bridge letter delivered to the DocuSign-signed email thread within 48 hours.

If you need any adjustments to the NDA language before countersign, please let us know; otherwise we’ll assume the DocuSign copy is acceptable.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: FintechCo_NDA_Countersigned.pdf (attachment stub)
